full_separation_rule: Require all original cross-plane interactions intersecting the candidate X column to be absent across every periodic Y bin, and contiguous advancement from initial tip. No proportional conversion from damage count.
nonlocal_bridge_guard: Also audit all surviving cross-plane segments whose X projection overlaps the column. A discrepancy with intersection-only front is an uncertainty strip; do not certify a unique new area or G until resolved. Full topology includes all long and periodic interactions.
global_connectivity_scope: An advancing finite crack can leave a connected path around its tip. One global component alone neither proves nor disproves local crack-face separation.
